title: Breckenridge History Museum

services.name: Now on Exhibit
services.desc: Moments the Made US As we celebrate America 250 and Colorado 150, the Moments That Made US exhibit, will look at key moments that helped to define our country. Alongside these moments, we will display local moments that helped to shape Breckenridge as we know it

services.name: guided tours
services.desc: Breckenridge History is committed to sharing our local history with students of all ages. Teachers can choose a visit to our downtown museums, a hike to learn about local mining operations, or a gold panning demonstration at a former mine site. Alternatively, we offer in classroom presentations (Summit County only)
